items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Now to finish off one party, this one party that I just started, was Red Norvo on vibraphones, and Ducky Pizzarelli on guitar, and Herb Ellis on guitar.

ctx.x: Aside from all this, just on the aside, all the piano players mentioned here are my heroes, as I put it, without their superb playing with me, I'm nowhere on the drums. Add to that list Teddy Wilson. He was there last year, too. Playing with Teddy Wilson -- gee, I did some work with his trio, quite a lot of it -- he keeps a drummer on his toes, especially using lots of brushes, because of Teddy's tempos -- they were breakneck. He does it so easy. And it's not that easy on drums to play softly applied sticks at…

Now to finish off one party, this one party that I just started, was Red Norvo on vibraphones, and Ducky Pizzarelli on guitar, and Herb Ellis on guitar. This line for a solid week should be awe inspiring for a jazz buff, or a musician.
